# Overview

The 5'UTR counterpart to `01_`'s CDS panels: how long are the 5'UTRs of the
expressed MDA-MB-231 transcriptome, and of the mRNAs eIF3d translationally
promotes in hypoxia, with a reference line at `r params$ref_utr5_nt` nt.

**Same transcripts, same groups, same estimator as `01_`.** The two gene sets
are built exactly as they are there and in `08_` - the expressed set is the
feature matrix's transcript per gene, the promoted set is `te_lfc > 0.5` and
`te_padj < 0.05` at hypoxia 1hr - and the panel is drawn by the same
`plot_density_luc`. So a 5'UTR panel and a CDS panel describe the same mRNAs
and can be read side by side.

**The distribution is strongly right-skewed, so there are two panels.** 5'UTR
length runs from a few nt to over 10 kb with a median near 130, which on a
linear axis is a spike against the origin and a tail nobody can read. The
linear panel is drawn clipped at `r params$xmax_nt` nt because that is the
panel that matches `01_`'s style; the **log2 panel is the one to read**, and
its legend still reports medians in nt, since the median survives a monotone
transform unchanged.

**The reference line is only interpretable with its percentile**, which
section 5 reports against both groups - a line drawn without one says where a
number is, not whether it is unusual.

# 1. Load Libraries

```{r load_libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(Biostrings)

source(here("code", "cds_reporter_design", "reporter_helpers.R"))
```

```{r params_chunk}
lfc_cutoff  <- 0.5
padj_cutoff <- 0.05

stopifnot(
  "ref_utr5_nt must be a positive length" =
    length(params$ref_utr5_nt) == 1 && params$ref_utr5_nt > 0,
  "xmax_nt must leave the reference line on the panel" =
    params$xmax_nt > params$ref_utr5_nt
)
cat("Reference line:", params$ref_utr5_nt, "nt | linear panel clipped at",
    params$xmax_nt, "nt\n")
```

# 2. The Two Gene Sets

Identical derivation to `01_` and `08_`, repeated rather than inherited so this
notebook fails on its own if the contrast or the matrix changes.

```{r load_promotes}
te_hyp <- read_csv(
  here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)

# Direction check. These files hold the sictrl_vs_si3d coefficient despite the
# filename stating the ratio the other way round, so positive te_lfc = eIF3d
# promotes. EIF3D's own rna_lfc must be strongly positive because the siRNA
# depletes its target.
eif3d_rna <- te_hyp %>% filter(symbol == "EIF3D") %>% pull(rna_lfc)
stopifnot("EIF3D rna_lfc is not strongly positive: contrast direction may be flipped" =
            length(eif3d_rna) == 1 && eif3d_rna > 2)
cat("Direction check - EIF3D rna_lfc:", round(eif3d_rna, 2), "\n")

promotes <- te_hyp %>%
  filter(te_lfc > lfc_cutoff, te_padj < padj_cutoff) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))
stopifnot("Expected 1604 eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes" = nrow(promotes) == 1604)
```

```{r transcripts}
fm <- readRDS(here("output", "predictive_modeling",
                   "feature_matrix_external_stability.rds"))
tx_all      <- fm %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)
tx_promotes <- tx_all %>% filter(gene_id_clean %in% promotes$gene_id_clean)

missing_gene_ids <- promotes$gene_id_clean[
  !promotes$gene_id_clean %in% tx_all$gene_id_clean]

tx_map <- read_tsv(
  here("accessories", "human", "tx2gene_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv.gz"),
  col_names = c("transcript_id", "gene_id"), col_types = "cc") %>%
  filter(str_starts(transcript_id, "ENST")) %>%
  transmute(transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", transcript_id),
            gene_id_clean       = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))

hyp_samples <- c("NM2025_0094", "NM2025_0095", "NM2025_0096")
hyp_files   <- setNames(
  file.path(here("2025_MDAcells_riboseq", "salmon"), hyp_samples, "quant.sf.gz"),
  hyp_samples)
stopifnot("Hypoxia siCTRL quant files missing" = all(file.exists(hyp_files)))

extra_tx_df <- map_dfr(names(hyp_files), function(s) {
  read_tsv(hyp_files[[s]], col_types = "cdddd",
           col_names = c("Name", "Length", "EffectiveLength", "TPM", "NumReads"),
           skip = 1) %>% dplyr::select(Name, TPM)
}) %>%
  group_by(Name) %>% summarise(mean_tpm = mean(TPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", Name)) %>%
  inner_join(tx_map, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean %in% missing_gene_ids, mean_tpm > 0) %>%
  group_by(gene_id_clean) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(mean_tpm, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(promotes %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol) %>% distinct(),
            by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)

tx_promotes <- bind_rows(tx_promotes, extra_tx_df)
```

# 3. 5'UTR Lengths

Taken from the same GENCODE v49 TxDb the CDS panels use. A 5'UTR can be split
across exons, so the length is the **summed exon width**, not the span from the
transcript start to the ATG - which would include introns and overstate it.

```{r utr5_lengths}
txdb <- AnnotationDbi::loadDb(here("accessories", "human",
                                   "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))
u5     <- fiveUTRsByTranscript(txdb, use.names = TRUE)
u5_len <- sum(BiocGenerics::width(u5))
names(u5_len) <- sub("\\..*", "", names(u5_len))

stopifnot(
  "Duplicate transcript IDs after version stripping" =
    !any(duplicated(names(u5_len))),
  "A 5'UTR length is not a positive integer" =
    all(u5_len > 0) && all(u5_len == as.integer(u5_len))
)
cat("Transcripts with an annotated 5'UTR in GENCODE v49:",
    fmt_n(length(u5_len)), "\n")

utr5_all <- tibble(transcript_id_clean = names(u5_len),
                   utr5_length = as.integer(u5_len))
```

**The extraction is verified against a column that already exists.** `01_` in
`code/predictive_modeling/` wrote `utr5_length` into the feature matrix from the
same annotation. Recomputing it here and asserting the two agree exactly is
cheaper than trusting either, and it is the check that would fire if the TxDb
were rebuilt differently or if `fiveUTRsByTranscript` were handed the wrong
grouping.

```{r verify_against_matrix}
check <- fm %>%
  transmute(transcript_id_clean, fm_len = as.numeric(utr5_length)) %>%
  inner_join(utr5_all, by = "transcript_id_clean")

stopifnot(
  "The feature matrix and the TxDb disagree on 5'UTR length" =
    all(check$fm_len == check$utr5_length),
  "Too few transcripts matched to make the check meaningful" =
    nrow(check) > 5000
)
cat(sprintf("Verified against feature_matrix_external_stability.rds: %s transcripts, max deviation %g\n",
            fmt_n(nrow(check)), max(abs(check$fm_len - check$utr5_length))))
```

**The panel is restricted to the transcripts the CDS panels also describe.**
Without this the 5'UTR and CDS figures would be drawn on two slightly different
sets and their n would differ for a reason that has nothing to do with 5'UTRs.
`build_cds_seqs` is what defines that set: in frame, terminal stop present,
`cds_end_NF` dropped.

```{r restrict_to_cds_set}
cds_ok <- names(build_cds_seqs(here("accessories", "human",
                                    "txdb.gencode49.sqlite")))

utr5_tbl <- utr5_all %>% filter(transcript_id_clean %in% cds_ok)

expressed <- tx_all %>%
  inner_join(utr5_tbl, by = "transcript_id_clean")
promoted <- tx_promotes %>%
  inner_join(utr5_tbl, by = "transcript_id_clean")

# What the restriction and the annotation between them removed, stated rather
# than left as an unexplained drop in n.
cat(sprintf("Expressed: %s of %s transcripts carry a 5'UTR and a complete CDS\n",
            fmt_n(nrow(expressed)), fmt_n(nrow(tx_all))))
cat(sprintf("Promoted:  %s of %s\n",
            fmt_n(nrow(promoted)), fmt_n(nrow(tx_promotes))))

# The promoted set is NOT a subset of the expressed set, by construction: the
# block above recovers a transcript from the salmon quantifications for every
# promoted gene the feature matrix has no row for, and those transcripts are in
# `tx_promotes` without being in `tx_all`. Asserting subset membership would
# fail on correct data. What can be asserted is that the augmentation is the
# ONLY source of the difference - anything else would mean the two sets were
# built from different transcript lists.
outside <- setdiff(promoted$transcript_id_clean, expressed$transcript_id_clean)
stopifnot(
  "5'UTR lengths must be positive" = all(expressed$utr5_length > 0),
  "A promoted transcript is outside the expressed set for a reason other than the salmon augmentation" =
    all(outside %in% extra_tx_df$transcript_id_clean),
  "Median 5'UTR length outside the expected 50-400 nt range" =
    between(median(expressed$utr5_length), 50, 400)
)
cat(sprintf("%s promoted transcripts sit outside the expressed set, all recovered from salmon for genes the feature matrix lacks\n",
            fmt_n(length(outside))))
```

```{r spot_check}
# Biological spot-check: TOP mRNAs - the cytosolic ribosomal proteins - have
# characteristically SHORT 5'UTRs, a pyrimidine tract right at the cap. If the
# extraction had picked up 3'UTRs, or summed the genomic span, this ordering
# would not hold.
rp <- expressed %>% filter(str_detect(symbol, "^RP[SL]\\d"))
stopifnot(
  "Too few ribosomal protein genes found for the spot-check" = nrow(rp) >= 50,
  "Ribosomal protein 5'UTRs are not shorter than the median: extraction suspect" =
    median(rp$utr5_length) < median(expressed$utr5_length)
)
cat(sprintf("Spot-check: %d ribosomal protein mRNAs, median 5'UTR %g nt vs %g nt transcriptome-wide\n",
            nrow(rp), median(rp$utr5_length), median(expressed$utr5_length)))

cat("\nExpressed 5'UTR length quantiles (nt):\n")
print(round(quantile(expressed$utr5_length,
                     c(.05, .25, .5, .75, .9, .95, .99))))
```

# 4. Panels

```{r density_setup}
group_cols <- c("All expressed mRNAs"    = "grey70",
                "eIF3d hypoxia promotes" = "#E69F00")

# The reference line. Black, per the project's color convention: grey and
# orange are spoken for by the two gene distributions, and orange is reserved
# for eIF3d, so a third hue there would read as a factor.
ref_tbl <- tibble(
  reporter    = sprintf("%g nt", params$ref_utr5_nt),
  utr5_length = params$ref_utr5_nt,
  color       = "black",
  linetype    = "solid")

# Lengths, not percentages, so the legend needs its own formatter - the helper's
# default would print "190.0%".
fmt_nt <- function(x) sprintf("%s nt", fmt_n(round(x)))
```

```{r panel_linear, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}
p_lin <- plot_density_luc(
  expressed, promoted, "utr5_length",
  xlab       = "5'UTR length (nt)",
  title      = "5'UTR length, MDA-MB-231",
  outfile    = "cds_reporter_13_density_utr5_length.pdf",
  luc_tbl    = ref_tbl, group_cols = group_cols,
  xmax       = params$xmax_nt,
  metric_fmt = fmt_nt)
```

The same data on a log2 axis. **This is the readable one** - the linear panel
above spends most of its width on a tail holding a few percent of the
transcripts, and compresses the range where almost every mRNA actually sits.

```{r panel_log2, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}
expressed_l <- expressed %>% mutate(log2_utr5_length = log2(utr5_length))
promoted_l  <- promoted  %>% mutate(log2_utr5_length = log2(utr5_length))
ref_tbl_l   <- ref_tbl %>% mutate(log2_utr5_length = log2(utr5_length))

# The legend still reports nt: the median of the log2 values back-transforms to
# the median in nt exactly, because the median commutes with any monotone
# transform. Reporting log2 units there would make the two panels look like
# they disagree.
p_log <- plot_density_luc(
  expressed_l, promoted_l, "log2_utr5_length",
  xlab       = "log2 5'UTR length (nt)",
  title      = "5'UTR length, MDA-MB-231",
  outfile    = "cds_reporter_13_density_utr5_length_log2.pdf",
  luc_tbl    = ref_tbl_l, group_cols = group_cols,
  metric_fmt = function(x) fmt_nt(2^x))

stopifnot(
  "Back-transformed log2 median does not equal the nt median" =
    abs(2^median(expressed_l$log2_utr5_length) -
          median(expressed$utr5_length)) < 1e-6
)
```

# 5. Where the Reference Line Sits

```{r percentile}
pct_tbl <- tibble(
  group = c("All expressed mRNAs", "eIF3d hypoxia promotes"),
  n     = c(nrow(expressed), nrow(promoted)),
  median_nt = c(median(expressed$utr5_length), median(promoted$utr5_length)),
  pct_at_or_below = c(
    100 * mean(expressed$utr5_length <= params$ref_utr5_nt),
    100 * mean(promoted$utr5_length  <= params$ref_utr5_nt))
)
print(pct_tbl %>% mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 1))) %>%
        as.data.frame())

stopifnot("Percentiles must lie in [0, 100]" =
            all(between(pct_tbl$pct_at_or_below, 0, 100)))

cat(sprintf("\n%g nt is the %.1fth percentile of expressed 5'UTRs and the %.1fth of the promoted set.\n",
            params$ref_utr5_nt, pct_tbl$pct_at_or_below[1],
            pct_tbl$pct_at_or_below[2]))

# Disjoint comparison, matching what the panels report: the promoted set against
# every OTHER expressed transcript, not against a pool containing itself.
rest <- expressed %>% filter(!gene_id_clean %in% promoted$gene_id_clean)
wt   <- wilcox.test(promoted$utr5_length, rest$utr5_length)
cat(sprintf("Promoted (n = %s, median %g nt) vs other expressed (n = %s, median %g nt): Wilcoxon p = %s\n",
            fmt_n(nrow(promoted)), median(promoted$utr5_length),
            fmt_n(nrow(rest)), median(rest$utr5_length),
            format.pval(wt$p.value, digits = 3)))
```

# 6. Outputs

```{r write_outputs}
outdir <- here("output", "cds_reporter_design")

write_csv(pct_tbl, file.path(outdir, "13_utr5_length_summary.csv"))
write_csv(
  bind_rows(expressed %>% mutate(group = "expressed"),
            promoted  %>% mutate(group = "promoted")) %>%
    dplyr::select(group, transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol,
                  utr5_length),
  file.path(outdir, "13_utr5_lengths_by_group.csv"))

cat("Wrote 2 tables to", outdir, "\n")
```
